αἰνεία: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader, son of Anchises; masc. voc. sg.
αἰχμητὰ: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. nom. sg., epic -ά (= Attic αἰχμητής)
αὐλώπιδί: αὐλῶπις — (of a helmet) tube-fitted, with a socket for the plume; fem. dat. sg.; exact sense uncertain
αὐλῆς: αὐλή — courtyard, fold; fem. gen. sg., with compounds of leaping: ’over, out of the fold’
αὐχένα: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐξ … ἄξῃ (tmesis): ’breaks the neck’
αὐχένος: αὐχήν — neck, nape; masc. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the neck’
βάλον: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλον): ’I hit’ · also aor. 3 pl. (same ending): ’they hit’
βαθέης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -έης (= Attic βαθείας), agreeing with αὐλῆς
βαλών: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having hit, by hitting’
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
βοσκομενάων: βόσκω — feed, graze (mid. intrans.); pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic βοσκομένων): ’grazing’
βουληφόρε: βουληφόρος — counselling, a counsellor; masc. voc. sg.
βουσὶ: βοῦς — ox, cow; dat. pl.: ’among cattle’ (after ἐν)
γιγνώσκων: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’recognising’
γιγνώσκῃς: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; pres. subj. act. 2 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that you may know’
γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’
γυάλοιο: γύαλος — hollow, curved (adj., from the noun γύαλον ’hollow plate’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with θώρηκος
γόον: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. acc. sg.
δίδου: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδίδου): ’he gave’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’
δίζυγες: δίζυξ — yoked in a pair, paired; masc. nom. pl., with ἵπποι: ’a yoked pair of horses’
δίφροι: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. nom. pl.
δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.
δαμάσσῃ: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic δαμάσῃ), in a general relative clause: ’he does not subdue’
δαρδανίδαο: Δαρδανίδης — descendant of Dardanus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), with Πριάμοιο
δατέοντο: δατέομαι — divide among themselves, share out; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἐδατοῦντο)
δηΐῳ: δήϊος — hostile, fierce; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δῄῳ), with πολέμῳ
διακλάσσας: διακλάω — break in two; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic διακλάσας): ’having snapped’
διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’looking for’
διόμηδες: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus; masc. voc. sg.
δοιοῖσιν: δοιοί (= δύο) — two; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), with ἀριστήεσσιν
δόμοις: δόμος — house; masc. dat. pl., plural for one dwelling, after postponed ἔνι (= ἐν): ’in the house’
δύεται: δύομαι — go into, enter, sink into; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’slips into’
εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
εἰλομένων: εἴλομαι (εἰλέω) — be crowded, pressed together; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. pl., gen. absolute with ἀνδρῶν: ’with men thronged’
εἰλυμένος: εἰλύω — wrap, cover; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg., with acc. of the part covered: ’wrapped (in cloud)’
εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
εἰροπόκοις: εἰροπόκος — wool-bearing, fleecy; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὀΐεσσι
εἰσορόων: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶν)
εἰωθότες: ἔθω (perf. εἴωθα) — be accustomed; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl. + inf.: ’accustomed to’
εὐρυδάμαντος: Εὐρυδάμας — Eurydamas, the dream-reader, father of Abas and Polyidus; masc. gen. sg.
ζώοντε: ζώω (ζάω) — live; pres. part. masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντε): ’alive’
θαρσῶν: θαρσέω (Attic θαρρέω) — be bold, take heart; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’boldly, with good heart’
θείην: τίθημι — put, set; aor. opt. act. 1 sg., in a condition after εἰ μή: ’if I do not put’
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., possessive with μῆνις: ’a god’s (wrath)’ · also gen. governed by ἄνευθε(ν): ’without a god’
θορὼν: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (θορ-): ’having sprung’
θόωνά: Θόων — Thoon, a Trojan, son of Phaenops; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
κέχυνται: χέω — pour; pass. be poured out, lie scattered; perf. mid./pass. 3 pl.: ’lie heaped, lie scattered’
κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
καλοὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. pl.
κιχήμενον: κιχάνω — reach, overtake; aor. part. mid. neut. nom./acc. sg., epic athematic (= Attic κιχόμενον), with βέλος: ’reaching’
κληῗδα: κληΐς — collar-bone; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κλείς)
κλόνον: κλόνος — turmoil, press of battle; masc. acc. sg.
κοτήεις: κοτήεις — wrathful, bearing a grudge; masc. nom. sg., epic (from κότος ’grudge’); predicate with θεός
κοτεσσάμενος: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having grown angry at’
κρῖ: κρῖ — barley (indeclinable epic form of κριθή); neut. nom./acc. sg.
κτεάτεσσι: κτέαρ — possession, property (mostly pl.); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κτήμασι)
κτῆσιν: κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. acc. sg., after διά: ’over the property’
λέοντα: λέων — lion; masc. acc. sg., in a comparison after ὥς τε: ’like a lion’
λεῖπ: λείπω — leave; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λεῖπ’ = λεῖπε, Attic ἔλειπε): ’left behind’
λιπέσθαι: λείπω — leave; aor. mid. inf. λιπέσθαι: ’to be left behind’
λυγρῷ: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg., with γήραϊ: ’grievous (old age)’
λυκάων: Λυκάων — Lycaon, Pandarus’ father; masc. nom. sg.
λυκίῃ: Λυκία — Lycia; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ), after ἐν: ’in Lycia’
μίγη: μίγνυμι — mix, join (+ dat.); aor. pass. (sense mid.) 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμίγη): ’mingled with’
μαίνεται: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; pres. 3 sg. mid.
μετῴχετο: μετοίχομαι — go after, go about among; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (μετ-ῴχετο)
μηνίσας: μηνίω — be wrathful, rage at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. + gen.: ’having been angered over’
μῆνις: μῆνις — wrath, rage (esp. a god’s); fem. nom. sg.
νεοτευχέες: νεοτευχής — newly made; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεοτευχεῖς)
νεφέλῃ: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’in cloud’
νοστήσω: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, with κε (= Attic ἐὰν νοστήσω): ’if I get home’
νώτου: νῶτον — back; neut. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the back’
ξάνθόν: Ξάνθος — Xanthus, a Trojan, son of Phaenops; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ξίφεϊ: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ξίφει): ’with a sword’
ξύλοχον: ξύλοχος — thicket, brush (a lair); masc. acc. sg., after κάτα (= κατά): ’through the thicket’
οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’
οὐτάμεν: οὐτάζω — wound, stab; aor. inf. act., epic athematic -μεν (= Attic οὐτάσαι): ’to wound’
πάνδαρε: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, a Lycian archer; masc. voc. sg.
πέπλοι: πέπλος — cloth, coverlet, robe; masc. nom. pl.
πέπτανται: πετάννυμι — spread out; perf. pass. 3 pl., epic (= Attic πεπέτανται): ’lie spread out’
πίσυνος: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
παρέασι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic πάρεισι)
πασσάλου: πάσσαλος — peg; masc. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the peg’
πατέρι: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg.: ’to the father’
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πειρώμενος: πειράω (mid. πειράομαι) — try, test; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’making trial’
πιθόμην: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι, obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. 2 mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπιθόμην)
πλῆξ: πλήσσω — strike; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (πλῆξ’ = πλῆξε, Attic ἔπληξε): ’struck’
ποιητοῖσιν: ποιητός — well-made, built; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), with δόμοις
ποιμὴν: ποιμήν — shepherd, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
πολλῶν: πολύς — much, many; gen. pl., of persons: ’of many (men)’
πολύειδον: Πολύϊδος — Polyidus, son of Eurydamas; masc. acc. sg. (Πολύειδος, with metrical lengthening)
ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., in a direct question
προμάχοισιν: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after ἐμίχθη: ’among the front-fighters’
προσαμύνει: προσαμύνω — come to the aid of, defend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
προϊάψειν: προϊάπτω — send forth, dispatch (to Hades); fut. inf. act., in indirect speech after ἐφάμην: ’that I would send’
πρωτοπαγεῖς: πρωτοπαγής — newly fixed together, freshly built; masc. nom. pl.
πτερόεντες: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; masc. nom. pl., epic -όεντες (= Attic πτερωτοί), with ὀϊστοί
πόρτιος: πόρτις — calf, heifer; fem. gen. sg., paired with βοός: ’of heifer or cow’
σακέσπαλος: σακέσπαλος — shield-brandishing (σάκος ’shield’ + πάλλω); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Tydeus; exact sense debated
σταθμοὺς: σταθμός — farmstead, steading; masc. acc. pl., after κατά: ’through the steadings’ · also door-post (same form)
στρεπτοῖο: στρεπτός — twisted, pliant; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), with χιτῶνος
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
τάμοι: τέμνω — cut; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic strong aor. (= Attic τέμοι): ’may he cut off’
τέκετ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 2 mid. 3 sg., elided (τέκετ’ = τέκετο), unaugmented: of a father, ’begot’
τείρετο: τείρω — wear out, distress; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτείρετο): ’was worn down’
τηλυγέτω: τηλύγετος — only and dear (late-born?); masc. nom. dual, of the two sons; meaning disputed
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’of this man’
τρυφαλείῃ: τρυφάλεια — helmet; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -εία)
τυδεύς: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. nom. sg.
τόξοισιν: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for one bow, with πίσυνος
τῷδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. sg., elided (τῷδ’ = τῷδε)
φαίνοπος: Φαίνοψ — Phaenops, father of Xanthus and Thoon; masc. gen. sg.
φειδόμενος: φείδομαι — spare, hold back (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sparing’
φθάμενος: φθάνω — come first, forestall; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φθάς): ’getting in first’
φοβεῖται: φοβέομαι — be frightened, flee in fear; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., with a neut. pl. subject: ’are terrified’
φορβῆς: φορβή — fodder, food; fem. gen. sg., gen. of lack after δεύομαι: ’lack fodder’
φρονέουσα: φρονέω — think, be minded; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσα)
φῖλαι: φιλέω — love, befriend; aor. imper. 2 sg., old athematic form (= Attic φίλησον): ’befriend!’
χαλεπὴ: χαλεπός — hard, grievous; fem. nom. sg.
χηρωσταὶ: χηρωστής — distant kinsman who takes over a childless man’s estate; masc. nom. pl.
χιτῶνος: χιτών — tunic, shirt; masc. gen. sg., after διά: ’through the tunic’
χραύσῃ: χραύω — graze, scratch; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’grazes’
ἀέκοντας: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἄκων), agreeing with ἵππους
ἀγκύλα: ἀγκύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τόξα
ἀγρῷ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. dat. sg., locative: ’in the country’
ἀγχιστῖναι: ἀγχιστῖνος — close together, in crowded rows; fem. nom. pl.
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’
ἀλαπάζοντα: ἀλαπάζω — lay waste, slaughter; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’laying low (the ranks)’
ἀλλότριος: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφοτέροιιν: ἀμφότερος — both; gen. dual, epic -οιιν (= Attic -οῖν): ’from both’
ἀνασχὼν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
ἀνηκόντιζε: ἀνακοντίζω — spurt up like a javelin; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound: ’spurted up’
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀρχεύειν: ἀρχεύω (= ἄρχω) — lead, command (+ dat.); pres. inf. act.: ’to lead’
ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’
ἀστύνοον: Ἀστύνοος — Astynous, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
ἀτρεκὲς: ἀτρεκής — exact, true; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, exactly’
ἀχλὺν: ἀχλύς — mist, darkness; fem. acc. sg.
ἀϊδωνῆϊ: Ἀϊδωνεύς — Aidoneus, a poetic name of Hades; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἅιδῃ): ’to Hades’
ἄβαντα: Ἄβας — Abas, a Trojan, son of Eurydamas; masc. acc. sg.
ἄδην: ἄδην — to the full, enough; adv.
ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ)
ἄξῃ: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a simile without ἄν; with ἐξ (tmesis, ἐξάγνυμι): ’breaks off’
ἄτρομον: ἄτρομος — untrembling, fearless; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
ἐέργαθεν: εἴργω (ἐέργω) — shut off, part, sever; aor. 3 sg. act., epic (= Attic εἷρξε): ’cut off, sundered’
ἐγχειάων: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with κλόνον: ’press of spears’
ἐδάμασσα: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. 1 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάμασα): ’I brought down’
ἐκέλευε: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept bidding’
ἐκνοστήσαντε: ἐκνοστέω — come home from, escape and return (+ gen.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having come back from’
ἐκρίνατ: κρίνω — judge, interpret, pick out; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ἐκρίνατ’ = ἐκρίνατο): ’interpreted’ · also ’chose, picked out’
ἐλαφρά: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; neut. acc. pl., predicate with γυῖα: ’light’
ἐλαύνειν: ἐλαύνω — drive, ride; pres. inf. act.: ’to drive’
ἐμίχθη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was mingled’
ἐμβεβαῶτα: ἐμβαίνω — step on, mount; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμβεβηκότα): ’having mounted’
ἐμμεμαὼς: ἐμμέμαα (μέμονα, with ἐν-) — press on eagerly; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, rushing on’
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐνάριζε: ἐναρίζω — strip a slain foe of his arms, slay; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept stripping, slaying’
ἐξάλλεται: ἐξάλλομαι — leap out of (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’leaps out’
ἐξέρυσ: ἐξερύω — draw out, pull out; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐξέρυσ’ = ἐξέρυσε)
ἐξαίνυτο: ἐξαίνυμαι — take out, take away; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’took away (his life)’
ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
ἐπεύχεται: ἐπεύχομαι — boast over, vaunt; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’exults, boasts’
ἐπιβαίην: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, mount (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I could mount’
ἐπῆεν: ἔπειμι (εἰμί) — be upon; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἐπῆν): ’was upon’
ἐρίζεται: ἐρίζω — contend, vie with (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’vies’
ἐρχομένοις: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl.: ’(to them) going’
ἐρχομένῳ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(to him) going’
ἐρῆμα: ἔρημος — deserted, lonely; neut. nom. pl.: ’the abandoned (ones)’
ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; gen. pl., as a noun of persons: ’of the brave’
ἐσόψομαι: εἰσοράω — look at, see; fut. mid. 1 sg., epic shortened ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσόψομαι): ’I shall see’
ἐφῆκα: ἐφίημι — let fly at, send against; aor. 1 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’I let fly’
ἐχέμμονά: Ἐχέμμων — Echemmon, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἑλεῖν: αἱρέω — take, seize, kill; aor. inf. act. (stem ἑλ-): ’to take, to slay’
ἑλόμην: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 1 sg. (stem ἑλ-): ’I took (for myself)’
ἑνὶ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc./neut. dat. sg. ἑνί
ἑστᾶσι: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 pl. act., contracted epic (= Attic ἑστήκασι): ’stand’
ἔασ: ἐάω — let be, leave alone; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔασ’ = ἔασε) · also εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic ἔασι (= Attic εἰσί), elided
ἔλθῃσ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι ending (ἔλθῃσι), elided: ’should she come’
ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
ἔσσευα: σεύω — set in motion, make flow; aor. 1 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔσευα): ’I made flow’
ἔφες: ἐφίημι — let fly at, send against; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’let fly!’
ἔχεσκε: ἔχω — have, hold, wield; iterative impf. 3 sg., epic -σκε (= Attic εἶχε): ’used to wield’
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἠρᾶτο: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἀ- → ἠ-)
ἡγεόμην: ἡγέομαι — lead, guide; impf. 1 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡγούμην): ’I led’
ἤγειρα: ἐγείρω — rouse, stir up; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented (ἐ- → ἠ-): ’I stirred up’ · also ἀγείρω — gather; aor. 1 sg.
ἧκα: ἵημι — send, let go, put into; aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I put in’
ἱρῶν: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. gen. pl. as a noun: ’of the sacred rites’
ἵπποισίν: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), accented before enclitic μ’
ὀΐεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
ὀλύρας: ὀλύρα — emmer, a coarse grain; fem. acc. pl.
ὀνήσειν: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; fut. inf. act., after ἔμελλον: ’to help’
ὀνειροπόλοιο: ὀνειροπόλος — dream-reader, interpreter of dreams; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
